topic_title: Obtaining, Possessing & Renewing Your Texas License
prompt: When a licensed Texas driver moves to a new residence address, within what legal timeframe must they notify the DPS?

options.text: Within ten days of relocating to the newly established residential domicile
Within sixty days of relocating to the newly established residential domicile
Within thirty days of relocating to the newly established residential domicile
Within ninety days of relocating to the newly established residential domicile
